variants.title: Range of Tl-204 betas in aluminium and Feather's rule
variants.sample: Sealed Tl-204 beta source (end point 763.7 keV)
variants.unknown: the range of the Tl-204 betas in aluminium and their end-point energy
variants.note: A single beta group. Feather's rule is strictly for end points above about 0.8 MeV, so here it gives the energy to a few per cent only; the Katz-Penfold relation is better at this energy. End point from NNDC, from memory - verify.
